from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAsset(BaseModel):
    """One company's total assets as reported in their financial statement."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    total_assets: float | None = Field(description="The reported total assets figure")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Scale of the reported figure: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period end date, e.g., 'March 31, 2024'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the total assets figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_assets: list[CompanyAsset]
